commit.message:
Add the bf CLI skeleton: every verb, stub modules, real doctor

Wires the full command surface from the plan (agents, board, claim,
heartbeat, release, note, stop, prs, run, doctor, serve, web) with
exit codes 0/1/2/3/64, adds stub modules with their final signatures
(agents, board, identity, prs, tui with the Source trait and Snapshot
rows) so PRs 4-6 compile independently, and makes `bf doctor`
lock-free (no hub, no database) so it works while `bf serve` runs.
Writer identity (identity.rs) is real: --as/BF_AGENT plus the observed
provider and pid from the /proc ancestor chain, with tests. Adds
ratatui/crossterm pins, clap `env`, and AGENTS.md with the board rules.

Plan of record PR 3: ~/.claude/plans/please-study-the-tips-snazzy-canyon.md
Built on top of the PR 2b prune (grok, #3).
